controller_placements.description: User-space task on the U54 application cores under Linux, memory-mapped register access and interrupt delivery through UIO, SCHED_FIFO with CPU affinity.
Bare-metal interrupt-driven loop on one dedicated U54 core in asymmetric multiprocessing, with Linux on the remaining cores for logging.
Fixed-point controller in FPGA fabric selected by a placement register; the processors only log.

excluded_content: SC-NeuroCore source code, generated neuron peripherals, models or adapters; adapters that place SC-NeuroCore peripherals in the device-under-test slot belong to the SC-NeuroCore repository.
Controllers, plant models or physics from other portfolio projects; only textbook PID and discrete LQR controllers are in scope.
Microchip Libero SoC binaries, licensed or encrypted IP cores, and redistributed vendor reference designs; they are generated or fetched at a pinned revision, never committed.
Board measurement results, datasets or benchmark numbers before a measured run with its manifest and hashes exists.
non_claims: No latency, jitter, deadline, energy or control-quality number has been measured.
No statement about PolarFire SoC performance is made before a measured run exists.
Hardware timing measurement from FPGA fabric is established prior work; this repository does not claim it as new.
No comparison with other vendors or platforms is part of the project.
No SC-NeuroCore latency or energy on PolarFire SoC has been measured.
purpose: Open, hardware-timestamped latency, deadline, fault and energy measurement instrument for real-time control loops and fabric accelerators on PolarFire SoC.

related_projects.relation: The COMPUTE event profile is designed to measure memory-mapped write, compute, read and interrupt paths of fabric accelerators such as SC-NeuroCore neuron peripherals; the adapters live in SC-NeuroCore.

target_platform.reference_document: Microchip DS60001679E, PolarFire SoC Icicle Kit User Guide
